claims.claim_text: Commitment to ban racial and religious profiling in law enforcement.
Support for ending all deportations and enforcement actions, immigration detention, private prison contracts, and deputization of local police forces.
Commitment to end racial and religious profiling in law enforcement.
Support for repealing the Law Enforcement Officers’ Bill of Rights, which protects police from discipline, nationwide.
Support for policies such as the Breathe Act that reinvest in Black and Brown communities and divest from policing.
Support for an end to the systematic torture and murder of Black and Brown comrades at the hands of the police and ICE.
